summary_points: This document is an engineering specification for the supply of instruments for the Solana project.
Revisions are tracked within the body of the specification.
The contract allows for alternate billing cycles upon request.
Confidentiality notice regarding the use and reproduction of information.
Supplier responsibilities include delivering materials to designated locations.
A single contact person is required for material tracking.
The document is an engineering specification for a temperature gauge.
It includes quality requirements and material specifications.
Vendor data commitment is crucial for project progress.
Equipment must be delivered to the purchaser's manufacturing site.
Shipment must adhere to a strict delivery schedule by August 2012.
Spare parts list with prices and delivery times are required.
The equipment will undergo inspection before shipment.
Alternate quotations are invited for improvements in price, delivery or performance.
Specifications follow accepted engineering practices and safety regulations.
All drawings begin with the prefix 4521-PLN-ANC.
The document is dated May/22/2012, May/09/2012, and Apr/04/2012.
It contains a list of temperature RTD elements with thermowells and transmitters.
There are two overflow tanks (MT-204A and MT-204B) with specified inlet temperatures and pressure ranges.
The document includes instrument tags for new instruments to be bid on.
warnings: The text is in a different language and may contain errors.
